read.thesis: Potash supply-demand tight with 2026 volumes 14.1–14.8Mt and controllable cost ≤$60/t; capex cut to $2.0–2.1B, Trinidad shut and phosphate under review signal capital discipline, though retail EBITDA guidance trails the earlier $1.9–2.1B range.

utilisation.quote: our operating rate averaged 87% in the second half

capex.quote: reduced capital expenditures to $2 billion, well below our Investor Day target of $2.2 billion to $2.3 billion

triggers.label: Capex cut to $2.0–2.1B for 2026
triggers.quote: Our capital expenditures guidance of $2 billion to $2.1 billion is consistent with 2025 and approximately $200 million below our Investor Day target.
triggers.highlight: approximately $200 million below our Investor Day target

triggers.label: Trinidad nitrogen shut, 1.6Mt out
triggers.quote: Trinidad nitrogen operations controlled shutdown due to high gas costs and limited profitability
triggers.highlight: controlled shutdown due to high gas costs

triggers.label: Benchmark potash ~20% higher YoY
triggers.quote: most benchmark prices approximately 20% higher compared to 12 months ago
triggers.highlight: approximately 20% higher compared to 12 months ago

triggers.label: $300M working capital build at YE
triggers.quote: Indeed, we had about a $300 million working capital build in the fourth quarter, which we expect to be released onto the ground here in the first half of the year.
triggers.highlight: about a $300 million working capital build

triggers.label: Retail EBITDA $1.75–1.95B vs prior ~$1.9–2.1B
triggers.quote: Retail adjusted EBITDA of $1.75 billion to $1.95 billion represents continued growth in our downstream business

guidance.quote: Our potash sales volume guidance of 14.1 million to 14.8 million tonnes is consistent with our global demand projection.

guidance.value: 9.2-9.7 Mt excl. Trinidad and New Madrid
guidance.quote: Our nitrogen sales volumes guidance of 9.2 million to 9.7 million tonnes is supported by reliability initiatives
we expect continued reliability benefits to support higher sales volumes with guidance of 2.4 million to 2.6 million tonnes
Retail adjusted EBITDA of $1.75 billion to $1.95 billion represents continued growth in our downstream business
Our capital expenditures guidance of $2 billion to $2.1 billion is consistent with 2025
On a full year basis, we expect controllable cash cost per tonne at or below our goal of $60 per tonne.

prior_guidance_check.quote: We raised our potash sales volume guidance twice during the year

prior_guidance_check.quote: Our Potash controllable cash cost averaged $58 per tonne for the year, below our $60 per tonne goal.
